name: splice-cached-pass2-order
body: splice_cached's pass-2 cached module records iterate a HashMap, so per-language counts are order-independent but the symbol emission order on the pass-2 path is nondeterministic. The pass-1 merge admits a cached real declaration over a planned placeholder, and the pass-2/pass-2b module guards treat any planned node as absent, so a superseded placeholder and the real cached declaration each emit one progress symbol at the same FQN; upgrade if a progress tally is ever asserted per final FQN. Pass 2b's Language guard remains `contains_key` because a plan-store placeholder is never a Language. Upgrade the module map to a BTreeMap when deterministic stream order is ever required.
